bibl.title: Contests and Clothing in Four Agonistic Papyri from Hellenistic Egypt.
bibl.seg: Stephen Sansom, Contests and Clothing in Four Agonistic Papyri from Hellenistic Egypt.
Christian Mann, Sofie Remijsen & Sebastian Scharff (edd.), Athletics in the Hellenistic World (Stuttgart, 2016) pp. 247-263.
bibl.note: Analyzes four extant papyri from Hellenistic Egypt that explicitly mention 'agon' in an agonistic context: P. Genova [P.U.G.] III, 107; P.S.I. IV, 364; P.S.I. IX, 1011; and B.G.U. VI, 1256. Each text presents different aspects of an athletic or hippic agon, though three have a specific interest in clothing. Moreover, while all these documents mention an agon, they primarily relate concerns other than the sporting events themselves.
